meta.title: DavIT Futures – custom software, .NET, Angular, FinTech
meta.description: DavIT Futures – Dawid Domagała. Web, desktop and backend applications in C# .NET, Angular and Blazor. 18+ years in banking, trading and SaaS. Wrocław, Poland.

hero.title: Software that
hero.lead: I design and build web, desktop and backend applications in C# .NET, Angular and Blazor. Since 2007 for banks, trading platforms, medtech and SaaS in Poland, Ireland, the Czech Republic and the UK.

about.title: About
about.subtitle: DavIT Futures is the one-person software house of Dawid Domagała: a senior developer and team lead with more than 18 years of commercial experience.

items.title: Finance and trading
items.text: Level 2 trading platforms, risk engines (LTV, PRIIPs), mutual fund distribution. I understand the market, not just the code.

items.title: Quality and security
items.text: Unit and BDD tests, CI/CD quality gates, zero-downtime releases. Experience with banking security audits.

items.title: Speed through AI
items.text: AI agents (Claude Code) speed up delivery, and every change is reviewed and tested. Fast, without cutting corners.

services.title: Services
services.subtitle: From idea and prototype to production release and maintenance.

items.title: Web applications
items.text: Modern apps in Angular, Blazor, React and Vue.js. Responsive, fast and easy to evolve.

items.title: Backend and APIs
items.text: C# .NET, REST and GraphQL, microservices, MS SQL Server. Performance, multithreading and stability under load.

items.title: Desktop applications
items.text: WPF, WinForms, DevExpress. Modernising legacy systems and migrating to new technology.

items.title: DevOps and CI/CD
items.text: GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins and GitHub Actions pipelines, automated releases, code signing, Docker and Azure.

items.title: Multi-tenant SaaS
items.text: White-label products with tenant data isolation and per-customer configuration and branding.

items.title: AI adoption in teams
items.text: AI agents in the delivery process, plus trainings and workshops for development teams.

tech.title: Technology
tech.subtitle: The tools I use every day.

projects.title: Projects
projects.subtitle: Selected commercial projects from the last 18 years, plus the code of this site.

items.name: DavIT Futures website
items.description: This site: Blazor WebAssembly on .NET 10, two languages, light and dark themes, automatic deployment to GitHub Pages with GitHub Actions.

items.name: L2 Dealer
items.description: Level 2 desktop trading platform. The “Price In Size” feature, a new leak-free TradeBook V2, and a full GitLab CI/CD pipeline (17k+ lines) rated HIGH maturity with zero-downtime releases.

items.name: LTV, PRC and PRIIPs risk platforms
items.description: Silverlight to Angular 10 migration with a GraphQL backend, monolith split into .NET Core microservices, regulatory KID documents (PRIIPs) with BDD tests across the whole API.

items.name: QiaCuity and QiaGuest
items.description: React/Redux UI for a Linux-based dPCR (digital polymerase chain reaction: precise DNA copy counting for medical diagnostics) laboratory instrument, and QiaGuest, a reception app built from scratch in Angular and .NET Core on Azure.

items.name: Focis
items.description: A complete multi-tenant SaaS product for law firms: document workflow, dynamic forms, tenant data isolation, push notifications and SMS login.

items.name: InCenter and InTire
items.description: Fleet tyre management across web, mobile and desktop with TPMS sensors. A proof of concept built in 2 weeks won a major contract.

items.name: White-label spirometry
items.description: Lung-function diagnostics for clinics and clinical trials, shipped in about 10 versions branded for pharma partners, including Roche.

items.name: Elemos
items.description: Software for the waste and recycling industry: a WPF office app and an in-truck handheld app with RFID, route planning and live vehicle tracking.

items.name: Goniec Online
items.description: Mutual fund sales system deployed in many Polish banks, handling about 70% of Polish trust fund transactions.
